chunks: And it has indeed been narrated:
"He should pray one rak‘ah standing and two rak‘ahs sitting."

key_terms.رُوِيَ: it has been narrated or reported

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on praying one rak‘ah standing and two rak‘ahs sitting in the chapter on forgetfulness in prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a concise legal ruling regarding a form of prayer to be performed as one rak‘ah while standing and two rak‘ahs while sitting. It belongs to the jurisprudence of salat (prayer), specifically within the rulings connected to forgetfulness in prayer.
